findings.title: Loss of precision when converting cents back to euros
findings.body: `toCents` converts a number of cents to a whole number of cents, but `depositCents` calls it on `rounded`, which is already an integer. This is a no-op and loses the unit conversion semantics. Remove the call to `toCents` and return `rounded` directly.

findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic used for money
findings.body: The calculation `totalCents(booking) * (percent / 100)` performs floating-point arithmetic, which can introduce rounding errors. Use integer arithmetic or a fixed-point library to avoid precision loss in financial calculations.

summary.problem: The new `depositCents` function introduces precision loss and uses floating-point arithmetic for money calculations.
summary.done_well: The function reuses existing utilities (`totalCents`, `toCents`) and follows the project's modular structure.
